title: QCOW (QEMU Copy-On-Write v1) signature
summary: A QCOW v1 file begins with the 4-byte magic 'QFI\xFB' (0x51 0x46 0x49 0xFB) with version 1.
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: QCOW1 is obsolete; QCOW2 is the standard.
QCOW supports copy-on-write, snapshots, and compression.
